Not many of us have friends these days, but if you do get them to play this game with you.

Having fun with friends you probably don't have, priceless !!
this game have very unique world and the gunplay just feels good, its must play

played the whole game with my partner, and it just felt unfinished.

the maps were pretty, but the bossfights felt pretty same-y throughout and the story was not compelling at all.

i feel like a lot of the challenge and interesting buildcrafting requires you to play new game plus, which is like...after the game? the fun and engaging content should be in the game from the start, not require you to play the game multiple times.

unlike a dark souls game, there isnt really any character-based questlines. after you get sucked up by the giant rock, the leader of ward 13 will ask you where clementine is, and then his character ends, repeating his "wtf is going on?" question every time you talk to him. this is repeated with every character in the game.

also, why is there an entire class hidden behind a blood moon event youre unlikely to ever see? that makes no sense.

Remnant 2 is better than remnant 1 And i loved the 1st !!! Way more build variety, as in, classes have skills, and aren't tied to armor. And 4 difficulties.I can confidently say it's much better. It takes what the first did and just makes it all around better. Alot of secrets, Hard elites and boss figths. Amazing graphics. 10/10 for me.

I always had a hard time with the Dark Souls games! I have never been great at games like this until I found Remnant 2! Basically in a very simple way of saying its like Dark Souls with GUNS! one of my all time favorites! I played about 100 hour on xbox and pre ordered and played from day 1! I highly recommend this game! I would pay full price for this game again honestly but was gifted while it was on sale which is amazing! I would consider picking this up if you have been on the fence at all!
We ran into too many technical issues with multiplayer to get past the one hour mark. Complete non-starter of a game.
I bought the ultimate edition and I'm still required to buy the dlc? Something's not right here. At least they're working on it
This is one of the best games I have ever played. This should be bigger than GTA and other mainstream games . Holy Shiit man !

The game's aesthetic is marvellous with great graphics, the gameplay is simple like most souls-like but it has its own vibe to it, difficulty is optimal and every aspect of the game is very balanced. Worth a try and with a very passive grind.

Dark Souls with guns 😎

The controls are great as are the graphics.

Lot of guns and trinkets so lot of different ways to play.

Huge amount of secrets to find !

For the story part, I prefer the first one (more linear) but I didn't finished the game so I didn't see the end yet...
Its quite fun. Its a lot of running down an alien corridor shooting aliens. Then eventually there's an boss fight. But its still fun.

It has been fun aside from the bugs and the occasional impossible-to-find secret. It is very unstable and crashes every single play session. When it crashes, it doesn't close by itself. I either have to close it with task manager or shut down my PC.

I only recommend this game if it is on sale. I think they kind of rushed this one. I mean it is still fun, but it feels like something is lacking. It has like this disconnected feel to it - maybe the writing? Plus, the combat could have been a little bit more smoother especially the relic use and movement.
Really good game I love it. To summarize its a mix of destiny and elden ring in my opinion. If you like those games then this is the game for you. Its a looter shooter but souls style format.

I spend 2 hours grinding the final boss with my friend on THE HARDEST MODE IN THE GAME going through mental torture as every attack one shots me and the boss has regenarator modifier, kill the boss just for the game to crash right before the credit scene and robbing me of the rewards for beating the game on the hardest mode

I had enough with the Remnant series. The combat and gamelay are solid, but what ruined for me was its FUCKING HORRIBLE MAP DESIGNS.

I quit midway in the first game because after I explored the whole map, defeat the boss, and killed everything I could find, I did not know how to proceed to the next area/segment/quest. I was totally stuck. Spent another hour or so looking thoroughly through the map and still had not a damn clue how to proceed. Didn't bother to waste another hour doing so.

I was stupid enough to purchase the second game because I thought this time shit like that in the first game wouldn't happen again (and also because the game was so damn fun when everything goes well). Then I got stuck again, and this time it happened in THE VERY FIRST MAP after finishing the tutorial. What an absolute cluster fuck. This is not an open-world game. How the fuck could the game still manage to get me lost and stuck, I have no idea. I only spent another 30 minutes wandering around the map this time to see if I missed something, and I knew the same bullshit happened again.

In conclusion, fuck this game.

Truly the most underrated souls-like game I've ever played!

The amount of what the fuck moments and the unique mechanic you will experience are countless, and the semi randomized zones makes the game extremely replayable, you just can't see everything by playing the game once or even twice.

I had no problems with the co-op experience as a host, and the only complaint form my buddy was that he cant see the teleportation menu.

Definitely recommended for souls like veterans and newbies because of the difficulties that the game offers, you can breeze through the campaign of suffer like never before so chose it wisely :)

Overall a 10/10 game with the only problem is that the game is too short. I will definitely come back and replay it after a while with a friend!
this game could have been a masterpiece had the devs spent more time and resources on polishing it. Constant crashes and freezes during victory are what truly drive me to give it a thumbs down.

The fact that I had to go through million hoops to get the game to not crash, on top of going to the official discord and discovering that a person had to roll back their GPU's device drivers just to get the one game to run, this game is a waste of money. I apologize but I wish I could have my money back.
What an awesome game. Even better than Remnant from the Ashes and that game absolutely rocked!

Definitely worth the time I spent on it.
Lots of weapons, classes, and builds make the game highly repeatable.

Although the game is challenging at higher difficulties, it's not that hard to beat. Yes, I must practice and memorize the boss patterns, but that didn't take long.

this stupid ass game has been giving issues since I bought it. It always shows invalid game sessions or offline when I join game. hace tried many ways to play with games but none work. i do not recommend

Very good entry in action-shooter genre, with a lot of depth and satisfying rpg elements.
Basically all elements that made the first one interesting are enhanced and vast majority of issues are fixed or redesigned.
I'd say that main story is serviceable but not great, stories of different worlds though are interesting and varied. Not to mention you won't see all of them on one playthrough. There are a lot of puzzles in this game and I enjoyed solving all of them. These are not too difficult, just enough to give you satisfaction and simply enjoy the experience. Bosses are also a highlight of the game. Honestly I have not been so enchanted by a game since Elden RIng. Strongly recommend, for anyone who likes shooters or Souls games as long as they do not mind, well shooting stuff as well,

This game is a masterpiece.I have over 1800 hours on PS5 and recently I bought the PC version too because it was super cheap.Fantastic guns,fantastic level design,fantastic bosses,fantastic build variety and fantastic coop experience with friends and even strangers.

Remnant 2 is an absolute blast to play, especially with your friends and even your kiddo — the perfect mix of challenge and chaos that makes every session unforgettable. This is peak co-op gaming at its finest, with intense fights, gorgeous worlds, and endless laughs. Can’t wait to see what kind of madness they cook up for Remnant 3!

Fixes a lot of issues from Remnant 1 but also breaks some of the appeal of Remnant 1 as well.

It's doing a lot more with its story which is helped by a cast of exceptional voice actors.

Enemies are more dynamic during combat than they were in the first game but there is still a lot of repetition among enemy types, Bosses are more interesting and (mostly but not all of them) are less prone to spamming you with minions.

Weapons feel more balanced, broadly, with more of them being viable. The same goes for Rings/Amulets and mutators.

The biggest problem with Remnant II is the same as Remnant I - builds being locked behind re-rolling content over and over and hoping you get lucky.

Love this game. Played the first one and fell in love with the game play then.
Always fun to keep finding new items and trying out new builds and see what works.
Amazing game. It's easier than Souls, but it's amazing, the artistic direction is SICK. Really a good surprise, underrated game.
Whoever designed the cube boss and made it mandatory deserves to be repeatedly kicked in the genitals for eternity. Turned a 9/10 game into a 3/10 game. Don't waste your time, energy, or money.

Met bug at some water pit. Dead and cannot progress the main quest again whatsoever.
In general, not so fun figuring out a puzzle which turned out to be a bug.

For gameplay, the enemy actions don't interact with you very well either.
Long overdue review on my end. This game made me never to want to buy a game from this studio again. "Developed with upscaling in mind" is a crutch and lazy excuse for bad optimizing.

Game is just a lot of fun. 
Shooting and combat feels good and can be enjoyed for multiple campaigns and still discover something new and worthwhile.

One of the most underrated games I've ever played and I don't use that word lightly. It has amazing maps and bosses, so many weapons. Not sure on armor yet but I've barely cleared 3 maps in the game and there are a few more to get through. It genuinely feels like Warframe or Destiny without the bloat and just focuses on the action with much more simplistic survival crafting approach.

The game itself is wonderful to get into, & the community tends to be very helpful, especially on the official Discord. 

Can be played solo, much more fun with friends. 
Plays up to 3, so grab two buddies!

Dark Souls with guns 2. The multiplayer is a little wonky because you can be teamed up with anyone around the globe, so I often get paired up with a person with Chinese characters in their name and my ping turns to dogshit and it becomes impossible to dodge. This is a really fun game though, basically the same as the first one with slightly better graphics and way more gear. The game strikes a good balance between holding your hand and letting you explore by telling you which zone you're supposed to be in but not explicitly pointing you in correct direction 100% of the time. Some of the puzzles fall flat but I just don't care for overly convoluted puzzles, so that's just me. It is fun to shoot bad guys.

After playing the game and beating the campaign. (With some DLC) I can say that while this game is good it lacks an intuitiveness that other games has and becomes a Wiki Game. A type of game where it isn't explainable enough/impossible to remember everything. While somethings can be impossible to get without a wiki, I personally don't mind it but I wouldn't be surprised if it did bother someone. 9/10 Some better game design with how to acquire archetypes and markers to indicate what objects you need for the campaign would make it a 10/10

I have poured an unholy amount of hours into Remnant 2 on Xbox when it released (over 300+ hours), fortunately I was able to convert my save via Game Pass to Steam. Since 2023 this is one of the best co-op experiences of its kind that I've had. There isn't a single game I have played more since 2023. Going in blind is highly recommended on the first play through-trust me. The way the game is designed is chef's kiss. Gameplay feels fluid and while not visually out of this world, graphics hold up well. Remnant 2 shines is in several categories, but build variety, secrets, and fun factor are second to none and on full display here. "Dark Souls with guns", is a relatively reductive way to think of this game and might set most up for disappointment if this is the expectation. The story is serviceable and there is some great environmental storytelling for those interested. Remnant 2 is best experienced cooperatively, but solo is plenty of fun and this is one of those games that I would recommend playing even if you can't get a group of friends together- it's that good. I'd advise against denying yourself this experience, off sale, on sale, in between sale, this game is a must play for those who enjoy shooters and exploration.

Buy it on sale if you're into the concept of walking around a LOT and shooting at the same basic enemies on a large scale per world, with sprinklings of elites here and there.

Trying to unlock anything specific requires 12 pages of the wiki open. You have to hope and pray you don't click the wrong option and get the other item that locks you out of the item you wanted- or even worse, hope your entire CAMPAIGN rolls properly to line up so you can get key item on world 1 to use it on (hopefully, if it rolls properly) Campaign 2 on World 3.

I've played 22 hours as of writing this review, and all but an hour of that has been trying to UNLOCK all of the stuff for my build so I can play on higher difficulties. This game is a slog.

I didn't last more than two minutes into the game. After creating your character, you are introduced to your first NPC, an insufferable black girlboss who immediately tells you how you are complete crap and that she is the one always saving you because you're crap. The only reason I brought up her race, btw, is because SHE DOES! Then her next lines are where she denigrates "some old white man". And you are forced to listen to this casual racism while stuck in slow-walk mode, unable to run, aim, shoot, dodge or anything else that might familiarize you with the controls to try and ignore the racist garbage the devs want to make certain you consume. Nevermind that in a post-apocolypse, would anyone really give a crap about race?? It completely pulls you out of the game's world and the only reason it is there is to hammer home the racism of the developers.

Don't buy games from racists.

I wish I hadn't purchased this game. I don't have the desire to grind a boss, get put in mostly impossible situations and die over and over. If struggling non-stop is your thing I'm sure this game is great but I just want to have fun and collect loot. I wish there was a tourist difficulty. I want to like the game but I just hate it. Get good or whatever, enjoy your grind its not for me.

Great game and enjoyed the randomization so that even after beating the game you can reroll campaign or use adventure to roll for different story/boss/secrets and go through it all over again.
So many secrets in this game that makes it worth going around every corner of the map to find but did not enjoy that your traits are capped to 65 so there were no point to leveling afterwards but hopefully they will increase the cap when they release a DLC along with some better gears.

Awesome game, can be the challenge you are looking for or go easier. Like a cross between Destiny, Elden Ring, and Days Gone. Definitely lots of little things you can miss if you aren't exploring the maps.
Souls like with guns is a very accurate description. Go solo and the co-op multiplayer is fantastic. You do not want to sleep on this one !

Played this game on a whin and it was one of the best decisions I've ever made. 
Fantastic gunplay and combat, heaps of build options, great class variety, and can go from relaxingly easy to punishingly hard depending on how you want to play. 

Not to mention the lore rules, I especially love N'Erud. 
All of the lore is incredible to deep dive into, what an awesome world.

Story is soo random, boring and illogical its frustrating. No immersion no cool back story and lore like it was in the first Remnant. Half the boses are just annoying no fun, half the maps are too big and uninteresting to explore and the worst insult is the ending just awful and stupid.

I played the game on release, i have almost 100 hours. In its current state it is unplayable. You "updated" your game so it is no longer playable, but you waited until it cannot be refunded. You are swine and dogherders.
So far so good. Very well made game with lots of fun in Co-op. Interesting boss fights that offer some challenge. Haven't experienced any bugs, performance or stability issues as of yet.

Underrated game.
I played Remnant: From the Ashes and it was just such a fun experience, I just knew I had to play this when it released.
It's always something new with the changing atmosphere and different paths you can take in the game.
You feel like your experiencing it from start.
Best game to play with friends.
Definitely some challenging boss fights and amazing game mechanics.
Give it a try it's really fun.
Great graphics, and playability, would like a little more history or direction on the quests

Fun shooter game for non-FPS veterans. There's additional abilities you unlock as you play and level different classes. It gives you a fair amount of room to experiment with on the lower end, but builds to get you through the highest difficulties can get a little samey. Good co-op game to play with friends on, can totally ignore the story and play on, and decent replayability.
